title: Translation and Literary Design of Matthew 5:27-30
caption: <bp-cite>Matthew 5:27-30</bp-cite>. Translation and Literary Design by Tim Mackie for BibleProject Classroom: The Messianic Torah (2024).
usx:
<usx version="2.6">
  <para>
    <group type="secondary">
      <group indent="1" sidebar-value="a">
        <verse number="27" /> You have heard that <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="black">it was said</char>, 
      </group>
      <group indent="2" sidebar-value="b">
        “You shall not <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="red">commit adultery</char>”; 
      </group>
      <optbreak />
      <group indent="1" sidebar-value="a'">
        <verse number="28" /> <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="black">and I say</char> to you that 
      </group>
      <group indent="2" sidebar-value="b'">
        everyone who <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="cyan">goes on looking</char> at a woman in order to cultivate lust for her, 
      </group>
      <group indent="2">
        he has already <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="red">committed adultery</char> with her in <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="blue">his heart</char>. 
      </group>
    </group>
  </para>
  <para>
    <group type="secondary">
      <group indent="1" sidebar-value="a">
        <verse number="29" /> If your <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="cyan">right eye</char> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="black">causes your downfall</char>, 
      </group>
      <group indent="2" sidebar-value="b">
        tear it out and <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="green">throw</char> it from you; 
      </group>
      <optbreak />
      <group indent="1" sidebar-value="a'">
        for it is better for you to lose <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="blue">one of your body-parts</char>, 
      </group>
      <group indent="2" sidebar-value="b'">
        than for <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="blue">your whole body</char> to be <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="green">thrown</char> into <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="tan">gehenna</char>. 
      </group>
    </group>
  </para>
  <para>
    <group type="secondary">
      <group indent="1" sidebar-value="a">
        <verse number="30" /> If your <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="cyan">right hand</char> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="black">causes your downfall</char>, 
      </group>
      <group indent="2" sidebar-value="b">
        cut it off and <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="green">throw</char> it from you; 
      </group>
      <optbreak />
      <group indent="1" sidebar-value="a'">
        for it is better for you to lose <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="blue">one of your body-parts</char>, 
      </group>
      <group indent="2" sidebar-value="b'">
        than for <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="blue">your whole body</char> to <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="green">go off</char> into <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="tan">gehenna</char>. 
      </group>
    </group>
  </para>
</usx>
